about: Leyline game modes: what the launcher's Modes page and /wrath/modes list. Checked by stream/playmodes.py (python3 -I stream/playmodes.py --check). Served at /wrath/modes.json.

modes.title: Minigolf
modes.line: Putt through courses that players built. Play alone or with your party.

modes.title: Bumper Balls
modes.line: Push the others off the arena. The last ball rolling wins.

modes.title: Coin Dash
modes.line: Grab the most coins in 60 seconds. Gold is 1, blue gems are 3.

modes.title: Community modes
modes.line: Minigames other players made, checked by a GM. Pick one and host it.

modes.title: Wrath Brawl
modes.line: A realm type: everyone starts at 80 in Dalaran with their class spells, riding and reputations.

modes.title: Azeroth Survivors
modes.line: A survivors-style roguelike: hold out against the waves. Runs in your browser with your own game folder, no server.

modes.title: Hordes of Azeroth
modes.line: A roguelike run by its own server. A realm type you host with the Host pack.

modes.title: 1v1 arena
modes.line: Rated or practice one-on-one arena at level 80. The battlemaster stands at the duel corner.

modes.title: Keystone dungeons
modes.line: Timed dungeons with a key that gets harder at every level, plus extra twists to beat.

modes.title: Transmog
modes.line: Change how your gear looks. The Warpweaver in Dalaran does it for you.

modes.title: Hardcore and challenges
modes.line: One life, slow XP, only gear you made and more. Start a new character at level 1.
